environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No WAF, no CSP headers injected by reverse proxy. Service runs directly via uvicorn on port 8000. The consent form HTML is served without any Content-Security-Policy headers. The /static/pkce-handler.js endpoint serves JavaScript without integrity verification at the transport layer.

config.tls: terminated at NLB with self-signed cert for internal traffic
config.network: public subnet, no security group restrictions on inbound
